## 3. Directory Layout & Core Files

```text
.
├── src/ (or app/)             # Primary application source code
│   ├── components/            # Reusable UI components
│   ├── lib/ (or utils/)       # Business logic and shared helpers
│   └── routes/ (or pages/)    # Page views and API route handlers
├── public/                    # Static assets (favicons, images, manifests)
│   ├── robots.txt             # Crawler guidance
│   ├── sitemap.xml            # XML sitemap
│   ├── llms.txt               # AI summary
│   ├── llms-full.txt          # Full AI context (this file)
│   └── .well-known/           # RFC 9116 security.txt
├── AGENTS.md                  # AI coding agent workflow and rules
├── CLAUDE.md                  # Claude Code operational instructions
├── GEMINI.md                  # Gemini CLI pointer
├── CONTRIBUTING.md            # Git branch strategy & PR guidelines
├── SECURITY.md                # Vulnerability reporting SLOs
└── README.md                  # Main repository README
```

---

## 4. Key Endpoints & Routes

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth Required |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| `GET` | `/` | Main user dashboard / landing page | No |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Healthcheck and readiness probe | No |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/security.txt` | RFC 9116 security disclosure | No |
| `GET` | `/llms.txt` | Concise AI context document | No |

## 5. Developer & Agent Guidelines

- **Agent Rules:** Adhere strictly to the definitions of done, startup workflows, and tech stack constraints in [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/[REPOSITORY-NAME]/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
- **Contributing:** Follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`) and branch protection rules in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/[REPOSITORY-NAME]/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Security Policy:** Report any vulnerabilities privately per [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/[REPOSITORY-NAME]/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
